items.t: Power relay assembly can overheat and catch fire (recall)
Hybrid clutch actuator oil leak can short out wiring (recall)
items.job: Free recall repair; clutch actuator replacement if out of coverage
items.note: Owners report a new clutch actuator outside the recall is an expensive repair.

items.t: Coolant can reach the power control unit and stall the car (recall)
Reduced power or creeping forward from a bad charger ground (recall)
Rear lug nuts may be loose (recall)
Car won't start or shuts down from a weak 12V battery
items.job: Test 12V system and find drain or replace 12V battery
items.note: On the hybrid the 12V battery is part of the high-voltage pack, so replacement costs more if it has truly failed.

items.t: Jerky or hesitant low-speed shifts from the dual-clutch transmission
items.job: Diagnose and update transmission and hybrid software
items.note: Clutch actuator or clutch replacement costs far more if parts have failed.

items.t: Check engine light from a tiny EVAP leak code
items.note: Free where the service campaign applies.

items.t: Electronic parking brake and Auto Hold warnings
items.job: Update parking brake software or replace rear caliper motor

items.t: Clunk or rattle from the steering column
items.job: Replace steering column worm shaft bearing

items.t: Braking feels uneven when switching from regenerative to friction brakes
items.job: Brake system software update and inspection

items.t: Hybrid warning lights from motor or control unit faults
items.job: Update hybrid control unit and DC converter software
items.note: Traction motor repairs cost much more if a part has failed.

items.t: High-voltage battery precharge fault code
Electric water pump leak or overheating
items.job: Inspect or replace electric water pump
items.note: Free where the service campaign covers it.

items.t: Check engine light for coolant temperature code P0128
Blind spot warning system fault
items.job: Diagnose and recalibrate blind spot radar

items.t: Wireless phone charger won't charge
items.job: Diagnose or replace wireless charging pad

items.t: Condensation inside headlights or taillights
Horn stops working
items.note: One owner was quoted about $800 out of warranty, which is far above typical parts and labor.

items.t: Warning light with communication code U1341
Remote start through the app doesn't work
